01 / THE JOB

Learn the drift.
Make the return trip.

STORY CAMPAIGN

One station.
18 reasons to go back.

Recover salvage, reactivate ordered relays, repair damaged systems, and escort the crew through 6 zones. Each four-room mission ends with a guardian: evade its dash, wait for CORE OPEN, then land your pulse.

Choose which middle bay comes first, then fly directly from the selected card. Completing power first disables the other middle bay’s hazard; supply first speeds up pulses there. Both bays are required. Next-bay cards show the upcoming objective, and Pause repeats the current one.

4 pulse rigs · Mission checkpoints · Pause and retry

ARCADE SORTIES

One more sector.
Or one safe payday.

Take on a repeating route of 12 compact maps, with pressure building on later loops. At the dock, Fly On starts the next sector with your current rig. Choose Change Rig when you want an optional replacement, or Bank Haul to secure the score and head home.

Your hull carries between sectors. Lose it all and the unbanked haul goes with it. A smaller score brought home still beats a fortune left in space.

One-press Fly On · Optional rig choices · Best banked score

03 / YOUR FIRST FLIGHT

Small inputs.
Deliberate moves.

  1. Choose Story, then a job.

    Up/Down selects. A confirms. On the flight deck, Left/Right chooses an unlocked rig. Read the objective, then A launches directly. Release and press A again when you want to pulse.

  2. Thrust, drift, brake.

    Tap the D-pad to build momentum. Release it to drift. Hold B to slow down before a turn or to interact beside a station.

  3. Finish the objective. Find the dock.

    Complete the task shown on the launch or dock card; press Start to reread it in Pause. Then return beside the actual dock terminal. Delivery is automatic. The bottom edge of a large room is not all safe dock.

04 / PICK YOUR SETUP

Built for Game Boy Color.
Know what is verified.

The native download is Starfall-Salvage-1.2.gbc. It requires color-capable GB/GBC hardware or emulation. It does not run on the original monochrome Game Boy or Game Boy Pocket, and it is not a .gba file.

Copy the ROM to a compatible SD cartridge
  1. Power off the handheld. Remove the cartridge’s SD card and connect it to your computer with a card reader.
  2. Extract the player ZIP. Copy Starfall-Salvage-1.2.gbc into a games folder on the card, outside the cartridge’s system folder.
  3. Eject the card, reinsert it, power on, and choose the game through the cartridge’s normal menu.
  4. Follow the cartridge manufacturer’s save procedure. Keep existing system files and saves.

No custom Chromatic firmware is required for this route. Chromatic USB is not an SD-card passthrough.

Keep your progress: checkpoints, saves, and Arcade

Story saves at checkpoints—not your exact position in the middle of a room. Choose Continue at the title to restore the committed stage. Retained room-entry briefings show CHECKPOINT SAVED. SAVE WRITE FAILED means you should not assume the write succeeded.

Arcade saves the best banked score; an unfinished sortie has no persistent resume point. Before upgrading, back up the existing ROM and battery save. Use your emulator or cartridge’s normal import/export or association process to connect a copy with Starfall-Salvage-1.2.gbc. Some setups match saves by ROM basename; a new filename does not automatically migrate progress. Keep the backup until Continue and a new save/reopen check succeed.

Browser saves stay in this browser at this site address, do not sync across devices, and are removed when browser storage is cleared. Allow the browser to finish saving before leaving. In the tested 1.2 browser setup, ordinary reload retained the 300-point banked best and Continue restored M03 Bay 1 with full hull. Earned route/mission checkpoints and 1.1-to-1.2 continuation were also checked. Native cold-start saves and full browser-process shutdown remain unverified; check persistence on your chosen setup.

What has been tested—and what remains

The exact native 1.2 ROM completed all 18 missions and 72 Story rooms, with 18 guardians, seven rescues and 31:26, Rank B. One M17 escort failure recovered through ordinary Retry. All 12 native Arcade sectors passed without retry, banking 22,500; same-session Continue restored the Story ending afterward. The fourteen-page illustrated manual and exact-ROM screenshots were reviewed. Targeted browser checks completed M01 and M02, all eight rooms, plus Arcade sector 1 after retry. Change Rig then Back kept the rig unchanged; Bank Haul saved 300 and ordinary reload retained both the best score and Story continuation. Direct launch and Pause/Retry were also exercised. No full browser campaign, complete Arcade cycle or browser clear time is claimed.

CLEAR TIME counts successful room attempts and excludes menus, pauses and failed attempts. First-time human completion time has not been measured. The owner confirmed 1.2 play on a Chromatic with an SD flash cartridge. Independent hardware validation, other setups, actual speaker/headphone listening, native cold-start and power-off-save checks remain separate. The title theme and animation are implemented; heard-audio review remains separate.
